summary: Backend only. New suite tests/test_photo_shred_missed_pickup_left_store.py: 11/12 pass. Photo shred works on both customer erase and the retention run. A real photo was uploaded with POST /api/upload, the stop was delivered through the API, then erased. The file now returns 404 'This photo was erased under the privacy policy', db.files has is_deleted=true and size=0, and the stored object really is 0 bytes. Missed-pickup alerts work: the trigger fires, a repeat run sends nothing new, the window edges are right (14:29:59 sends nothing, 14:30 sends, 17:29:59 does not send for evening, 20:29:59 sends for evening, 17:30 is past the afternoon 3h limit and sends nothing), a stop with no route counts as missing, no alert goes out when everything is checked in, the endpoint is admin-only (401 with no login, 403 for merchant and driver) and a bad 'at' returns 400. Left-store SMS: one log for each pending or arrived stop, none for delivered stops, the wording matches the spec exactly with the window, status is skipped_fictional, a second check-in does not text the same stop again, and a duplicate check-in returns 400. One failure: the store name goes into the text unchanged, so a store named with 'Pharmacy' puts that word in the SMS. Regression suites (customer_requests_pickup_checkin, privacy_compliance, rx_handoff_batch_alerts, run with -n 0): 51/51 pass.

minor.issue: The store name (m['name']) goes into the SMS unchanged. A pharmacy merchant named e.g. 'Main St Pharmacy' / 'X Drug Mart Pharmacy' leaks the word 'pharmacy' into a lock-screen text, which breaks the rule that the text never names medication or the pharmacy type. Reproduced by temporarily renaming mer-2 to 'TEST Main St Pharmacy': message = '...from TEST Main St Pharmacy has left the store...'.

If put_object fails, the file record is NOT marked deleted, but erase_stops still sets pod_photo_path=None. The photo stays in storage with no stop pointing to it, nothing retries it, and it can still be served to staff by its path. Suggest keeping a 'pending shred' list, retrying it, or setting is_deleted before or regardless of the overwrite.
datetime.fromisoformat(at).replace(tzinfo=TZ) quietly drops any offset the caller sends (e.g. '...Z' or '-05:00' is treated as Eastern). Low impact because this is a test hook.

Missing drops are counted without looking at stop status. Stops that were already failed or erased, or that were moved off the manifest, would still count as 'not collected'. Consider counting only pending/arrived.

action_items: text_patients_left_store: remove the store name from the SMS, or remove words like pharmacy/prescription/medication/Rx/drug from it, e.g. use a neutral name or just 'your local store'.
shred_files: still mark db.files is_deleted=true (or queue a retry) when the storage overwrite fails, so an erased photo can never be served again.
Optional: in missed-pickup counting, ignore failed or erased stops; respect the offset in the 'at' parameter.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 5319 lines; split it into routers (privacy, pickups, files, alerts).
Missed-pickup dedupe record is inserted before the email is spawned. If the email gets a 429 (seen in logs during tests) the alert is never retried. Acceptable, but consider storing the email status.
The backend uses uvicorn --reload watching backend/, so creating or editing files under backend/tests reloads the server while tests run. Background loops restart and the 25-30s startup sleeps reset.
seed_data_creation: Test stops use id prefix TEST_ and manifests on 2030-01-15/16 so the live background loop never picks them up. They are removed in teardown together with pickups, missed_pickup_alerts, contact_logs and db.files 'TEST_pod.png'. mer-2 name was renamed for a moment and restored to 'Bay Books'. pharmacy_partner is still true and pricing was not touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use only 555-01xx numbers (FICTIONAL_NUMBER ^\+1\d{3}55501\d{2}$) because Twilio is LIVE. In this run, an early version of the suite used +1519555096x and sent 3 real SMS (status 'queued'); fixed to 555-019x. The missed-pickup hook sends real emails to the admin address and delivered@resend.dev; 429s are expected. The upload endpoint is POST /api/upload (singular). Run suites with -n 0.
rca_of_issue: Store-name leak: text_patients_left_store builds the body with f'from {m.get("name")}' and never cleans it. Pharmacy partners' names often contain 'Pharmacy'. Fix: use a neutral label or remove those words.
